train_cache_manifest.target_contract: SMPL joint-based root-frame pRB target. joint_pRB = (joints[:, [18,19,4,5,15]] - joints[:, 0:1]) @ root_R. This is not the legacy IMU-vertex pRB target.
train_cache_manifest.feature_layout: aRB[18] + wRB[18] + RRB[45] + gR0[3] + frozen_joint_acc_R[15] + root_acc_smooth_R[3]

source_manifest.offset_contract: offset_r is sequence-level r_JS with shape [6,3]: IMU origin relative to mapped joint, expressed in joint-local coordinates. It is copied from processed data and is not repeated per frame.

train_cache_manifest.pl_base_source_detail: GPNet.plnet official PL-s1 RNN on legacy 84D IMU input; base is diagnostic only.

target_control_fit_contract.objective: min_C wp||S C - x||^2 + wv||D1 C - fd_dot(x)||^2 + wa||D2 C - fd_ddot(x)||^2 + wr||C||^2

finite_difference.velocity: central difference with one-sided endpoints, divided by dt
finite_difference.acceleration: three-point second difference with endpoint copy, divided by dt^2

target_control_fit_contract.note: Use fit_uniform_cubic_spline_controls_position_only for historical exact sample reconstruction.

notices: legacy vertex pRB target is not used as training target.
PL output target changed to SMPL joint pRB.
frozen acceleration predictor is eval-only and not trained.
no acceleration target output; acceleration is an auxiliary input and decoded trajectory evaluation target.
